open_questions: Centroid difference image remains inconclusive (centroid not_run/no sector with clear image) - follow-up difference imaging or ground-based on-target photometry would confirm source in pixel.
Odd-even departure 3.686 sigma with sector_oe_max_sigma 6.791 - additional transits to average out spot-induced apparent depth scatter and tighten odd/even test.

dossier.public_summary: A shallow 613 ppm dip repeats every 13.1 days around a spotted K dwarf with a flat bottom and no secondary eclipse, implying a ~2 Earth-radius planet. The small out-of-eclipse swing and lack of plausible nearby eclipsers make a planet the best explanation. The odd-even depth difference and variable star scatter remain to be checked with more transits and on-target imaging.

reasons.why: Planet-sized (below 10 Rearth) and consistent with transit shape: shape.v_sigma 1.186 flat not V, duration ratio 1.352 plausible central for 0.767 Rsun star, TIC radius 0.7673 Gaia FLAME 0.7289782166481018.
Small against depth 612.6 (ratio 0.2697) and large chi2 not on target: chi2 29.02 dof 9 fits planet not close binary. Spot amplitudes 1410/6355/4612 with star VARIABLE explain residual.

Below 4-sigma strong threshold; bright K dwarf at Teff 4454, Tmag 10.28 and VARIABLE will inflate sigma. Depths 815.8 vs 440.1 ppm ppm difference 375.6 within red noise 1.17 and across 6 transits is not decisive for binary at twice period.

Difference imaging not run (centroid_all not_run) and no plausible neighbour: plausible_within_1px 0, could_cause_within_1px 0, contratio 0.0145. Closest that could need eclipse >29% at 38-48 arcsec outside 21-arcsec pixel.
Depth change 44.35% across sectors 18 494, 58 557, 85 762 ppm not significant at p>0.01 and does not imply binary; consistent with spot contamination on variable star.

Low rank driven by Ruwe 0.8918, excess_noise_sig 5.393, VARIABLE flag and odd-even, none showing positive EB evidence (secondary snr 2.758, phase_curve small). Does not outweigh flat bottom small size and on-target consistency.
